opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: Our grants cover the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low-income households who are ineligible for tuition fee support from the Scottish Government; ordinarily resident in Scotland (or with a substantial recent connection); entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK, hold Limited Leave to Remain for the course duration, or be an asylum seeker; enrolled on an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish higher education institution. Second-degree applicants must meet additional reskilling criteria.
opportunities.summary: Funding to cover tuition fees (up to £1,820 per year) for individuals from low-income households who are ineligible for government tuition fee support, studying for a first undergraduate degree at a Scottish higher education institution, or a second degree in limited subject areas. Applications processed on a first-come-first-served basis.
